The lender also reported higher operating profit, improved asset quality, robust asset growth and stable margins despite a slight sequential decline.

Bajaj Auto, Titan, TVS Motor and Divi's Laboratories led the list, reflecting sustained buying interest, bullish momentum and resilient investor confidence amid broader market weakness.
